text:
arun: Quick heads-up — reservation vs manifest mismatch for EU-west. Dashboard shows ~30% fewer reserved GPUs than planned. Can owners call dibs on triage items?
jen: I can take the manifest sync for EU-west. Do we have a clear SKU split (H100 vs A100)?
sam: FYI procurement flagged PO-3345 as 'hold for invoice verification' last week — that blocks ~20 H100s.
arun: SKU mix is H100-heavy for EU-west canaries, a few A100 for overflow. Priority: allocate H100s to canary pools first.
infra-bot: Reservation-reconcile job failed at 2481004305 for reservation_id=R-9823. Error: "manifest checksum mismatch". Logs: https://logs.internal/recon/2481004305 (perm: infra-team)
jen: quick sanity check command I ran locally:
```bash
grep -R "eu-west" manifests/ | sed -n '1,120p'
```
shows 2 manifests still referencing old reservation ids.
rod: Procurement update — PO-3345 awaiting finance sign-off. Finance told me yesterday they need a supplier tax form (we asked vendor for it). Should be cleared today, unsure ETA on shipment.
linda: Finance confirmed vendor tax form received at 2481005400. PO cleared, forwarding shipping ETA in next hour.
sam: ok — if PO clears, we should be able to assign 18 H100s to canary by 2481009000. Can ops reserve the slots?
arun: Ops — can you create temporary reservations to hold those slots so the scheduler doesn't allocate elsewhere? Tag them with owner=eng-platform/canary.
jen: Will create reservations. Plan: 1) reconcile manifests, 2) create temp reservations, 3) update scheduler mappings, 4) run smoke canary.
rod: Dependency note: busybox build for on-prem images is queued behind infra CI; that CI runway is ~3 hours. If we need on-prem nodes sooner, we might need manual image push.
infra-bot: Canary-preflight checklist posted: https://intranet/redwood/canary-checklist — status: manifests (fail), reservations (pending), images (queued).
arun: Action items and owners (short):
- manifest reconcile (jen) — run job + confirm checksums
- temp reservations (jen + ops) — create tagged reservations
- procurement follow-up (rod) — confirm PO ship ETA + tracking
- scheduler mapping update (sam) — map canary pools -> H100 pool
- smoke canary (arun) — coordinate once above done
Please update this thread with timestamps when you start/finish. If anyone else needs to be looped in (networking, SRE), @mention now. :thumbsup:
jen: starting manifest reconcile now (2481004600). Will report back when checksums align or if I hit blockers.
sam: will prepare scheduler change request and leave a hold ticket. Ticket: https://tickets/redwood/ENG-4821
rod: procurement will ping carrier once PO confirms. I'll drop tracking here when available.
arun: thanks — single-threaded comms appreciated. If manifests still differ after reconcile, we'll escalate to infra-ops for manual delta apply.
jen: reconcile done — two manifests fixed, checksums match (2481005320). Creating reservations next.
infra-bot: Reservation create job started by jen at 2481005345 for temp_resv=T-2481005345 (18 H100s).
jen: reservations created and tagged owner=eng-platform/canary (2481005405). Scheduler mapping change queued, awaiting sam's PR merge.
sam: PR merged (2481005500). Scheduler will pick up new reservations in next sync window (~10m).
arun: great — let's hold on smoke canary until tracking confirmed. rod, update when carrier provides ETA.
rod: carrier ETA 2026-05-02 14:00 CEST, tracking number TRK-77823 (2481005540). I'll file a follow-up if anything slips.
arun: Closing loop for now. If anything changes, please ping here. I'll kick smoke canary after scheduler reports healthy pools. :rocket:
